changes.detail: Added an S15b-only strict completeness predicate requiring a non-empty symbol, requested depth on both sides, finite positive prices, and finite positive quantities for every checked level.
Added regression coverage for valid depth, zero-price asks, zero-quantity bids, missing snapshots, and invalid depth.

remaining_status.historical_kis_orderbook: one-sided only; all ask levels have zero price and zero quantity
remaining_status.production_shared_is_complete_predicate: unchanged; remains a separately tracked issue outside this validation-only scope

notes: The strict predicate is isolated to the S15b validation-only adapter and does not promote synthetic validation evidence to production authority.
The quote supplement contains no order-book quantities/depth; adapter.order_book continues to return None rather than inventing depth.
The legacy shared OptionOrderBookSnapshot.is_complete() remains unchanged and is explicitly shown by regression tests to be permissive for malformed zero-price/zero-quantity levels.
